main_measure.name: mean short-direction unusual 7-bar move

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 to confirm (with slope > 0, t >= 2); mean < 0 with t <= -2 or slope < 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of unusual move on |forecast|

decided_by: Inconclusive: the mean or slope has |t| below 2, meeting neither confirm nor reject. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction -0.893 (below 1), 257 cases (30 needed).
reading: Profile on a bar is read from the detector's recorded regime (not 'chop'), since its components are not recorded and their 365-bar lookback cannot be rebuilt inside a window; the streak is the recorded raw value of broken_up_run, else recomputed from closes; the case's first bet in each 7-bar grid cell is kept; the slope's t is the ordinary OLS t; the plan's 'fewer than 40 cases or days' minimum is reported as 'not observable'.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction -0.893 (below 1), 257 cases (30 needed)
